identity.name: Hazrid Azad Bin Shaharudin
identity.summary: Senior software engineer with full-stack experience across backend microservices, web and mobile applications, and cloud-native platforms. Leads delivery and mentors engineers across banking, aviation, and telecom, with hands-on work in LLM tooling, provider integrations, and agentic developer systems.

career.summary: Core contributor to MAE payment and transfer flows for Cambodia and the Philippines; built React Native performance and framework patches, app security features, and a GrowthBook-configurable Axios cache with bounded LRU eviction.
Built the AirAsia Xchange mini app in Flutter and Dart and delivered Spring Boot microservices on Google Cloud plus React and Next.js interfaces across the AirAsia Rewards ecosystem.

Led reviews and mentoring, improved Kubernetes rollouts with Istio on GKE, integrated SonarQube into Jenkins, and helped deliver Boost Game Store from infrastructure to React and Spring Boot product surfaces.
Implemented service logic and network integrations in Comptel OSS FlowOne, co-designed MPLS L3VPN topology, optimized backend performance, and developed the Network Element Interface.
